patch.value: Replace the dynamic SDK runtime import with a typed top-level import and remove all source any

index.ts launders the SDK runtime through an inline await import typed as any (line ~786) and carries four more any sites: the __invalid filter cast in runImport and three command handlers typed ctx:any. The dynamic-import shim rested on a since-disproven premise that extensions cannot resolve the SDK at runtime. Convert to a typed top-level import from @unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/runtime, give parsed records a real type carrying the __invalid marker, and type handlers with the SDK CommandHandlerContext.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Investigation: the shim guards runtime.listAllFrontMatter, which does NOT exist in the installed @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.7.27 SDK (verified: import('@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/runtime').then(m => typeof m.listAllFrontMatter) === 'undefined'), so the SDK branch is dead code today and every validate run already takes the pm list-all spawn fallback. The SDK runtime subpath exports listAllItemMetadata(pmRoot): Promise<ItemMetadata[]> (runtime.d.ts line 72, re-exported from core/store/item-store.js). ItemMetadata has required description plus an index signature, so the bead_id provenance marker recovery (decodeBeadId) works off a projected subset. CommandHandlerContext (sdk/authoring -> core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts line 440) is the real handler ctx type: command/args/options/global/pm_root, with --json on ctx.global per contract.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Done. Dynamic import replaced with top-level: import { listAllItemMetadata } from '@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk/runtime' (real export name, verified in dist/sdk/runtime.d.ts line 72 and live in dist/cli-bundle/sdk-runtime.js). readWorkspaceBeadIds projects ItemMetadata to the bead_id/description/body subset decodeBeadId reads, narrowing index-signature unknowns with typeof guards; spawn fallback (pm list-all) retained on SDK read failure. any removals: (1) runImport filter now reads ParsedBeadsRecord (= BeadsItem & { __invalid?: boolean }) so the sentinel needs no cast; (2) beads-export, beads validate/x2, beads diff/x2 handlers now take CommandHandlerContext from sdk/authoring; ctx.global (GlobalOptions, no index signature) is spread into a fresh object literal for readBoolOption/parseDiffOptions Record<string,unknown> params, keeping --json on ctx.global per contract. Gates: npm run build OK, npm test 85/85 pass, npx tsc --noEmit OK, changelog:check OK, gate grep prints nothing. Activation proof in /tmp/pm-beads-proof (pm init --pm-path .agents/pm; pm install <local path>; activation_diagnostics.failed_count: 0): pm beads --help lists diff/export/import/validate with full descriptions, exit=0; pm list --json returns real JSON; pm health ok:true; import of 2 beads -> Imported 2, linked 1 dependency edge; validate post-import OK 2 records no issues (workspace cross-check exercised the new SDK store read); export round-trips bd-1/bd-2 with dependency edge intact; pm beads diff --json and hyphenated aliases beads-export/beads-validate all exit 0.

patch.value: Dynamic SDK runtime import replaced with typed top-level listAllItemMetadata import; all five any sites removed (ParsedBeadsRecord sentinel type + CommandHandlerContext handlers); build/typecheck/85 tests green; real-host activation proven in /tmp/pm-beads-proof with full import/validate/export/diff round trip.
